data.title: Bitcoin ETFs Dodge the Inflow Slump That Caught Ethereum, Solana, and XRP
data.description: Bitcoin ETFs drew $986.9 million while Ethereum, Solana and XRP fund inflows collapsed. Price gains stayed modest across the board.
data.keywords: Solana, Bitcoin, XRP, Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum, Hyperliquid, The week ending August 28
